forum.title: Using 2 SAI as master / slave to reduce latency on Nucleo F756ZG
forum.content_text:
Hello everyone,

I am currently working on a project on Nucleo F756ZG where I need to :

* Use SAI1A and SAI2B to send audio data at the same time using TDM with 8 slots each

* SAI parameters are 128 bits data frames (so 16 bits per slot)

* Audio frequency 96k

* Master mode

* Use of HAL\_SAI\_Transmit\_DMA to send the data

I managed to configure the SAIs, send and monitor the output data and it is working well but I noticed (an obvious I guess) latency between the payloads of the signals, between the 2 calls of the HAL\_SAI\_Transmit\_DMA function, as you can see on the screenshot (12 us approximately).

I would like to reduce this latency under 1 microsecond if possible. During my experimentations I noticed it was possible to set one SAI as master and the other one as its slave and only call HAL\_SAI\_Transmit\_DMA once, but haven’t managed to make it work for now. Is it really possible ? I am looking for a code example to be sure to setup the SAIs properly.

I can share more details of my code if necessary.

Thanks!

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/40c57f6c-253b-44f0-acf1-12ba8eccfae1.png)

SD pin monitored for SAI1A and SAI2B
